titulo: Stuck in 2026, Ep. 3: The Brain Made of Sand
tema: Stuck in 2026, episode 3: Kip learns how a silicon chip is made from sand and fits one into his time machine
perguntaCentral: How does ordinary sand end up as the brain of a phone?

reliquia.descricao: a loose green circuit board from an old phone of the 2020s, with thin copper lines and one small black square chip in the middle; no battery, no brand

cenas.acao: In Ben's garage, Kip opens a tiny cover on his cracked Chrono-Band and finds its little processor burned black, with a wisp of smoke.
cenas.narracao: Power was only half the problem. Inside my Chrono-Band, its tiny brain had *burned out*. And nobody here sold parts from the future.
cenas.visual: Garage, the time machine frame standing on the right with the watch and the power bank in two of its six slots. Kip raises his left wrist; at 'Inside' the band's cover flips open in a magnifier; at 'burned out' the little chip inside is black with a curl of grey smoke. At 'nobody' Kip shrugs.

cenas.acao: Ben opens a drawer under the workbench and holds up a loose green circuit board from an old phone, with a small black chip in the middle.
cenas.narracao: Ben dug through a drawer and found an old phone's circuit board. In the middle sat a small black square: a *chip*.
cenas.visual: Ben pulls a drawer under the bench at 'drawer', rummages, and lifts a green circuit board at 'circuit board'. At 'black square' a magnifier shows the chip; at 'chip' it glows.

cenas.acao: Kip fits the board into the third slot of the machine frame; it clicks and lights up; Ben points at the chip and a small pile of sand appears in a thought bubble.
cenas.narracao: I fitted it into my machine's third slot. Then Ben said something strange: chips like this start out as *sand*.
cenas.visual: Kip carries the board in his right hand to the machine frame and slides it into slot 3 at 'third slot' (click, slot glows). Ben, behind him, says the line (dramatization, no lip sync); at 'sand' a thought bubble with a small sand pile pops above Kip, who looks shocked.

cenas.acao: Diagram: a pile of silica sand turns into a lump of pure silicon, grows into one big cylindrical crystal and is sliced into thin shiny discs.
cenas.narracao: Factories purify the silica in sand into almost perfect *silicon*, grow it into one big crystal, and slice it into thin discs.
cenas.visual: A left-to-right flow above the caption zone: sand pile ('silica'), arrow, grey shiny lump ('silicon') at 'silicon', arrow, a tall cylinder pulled up from a glowing pot at 'crystal', arrow, the cylinder sliced into thin shiny wafers at 'slice'. Kip small in a corner.

cenas.acao: Light shines through a stencil-like mask onto a wafer, printing a pattern; layers stack up; a zoom shows a grid of tiny switches blinking on and off.
cenas.narracao: Then light prints circuit patterns onto each disc, layer after layer, until one chip holds *billions of transistors*: tiny on-off switches.
cenas.visual: A big wafer disc; a lamp shines down through a mask at 'light' and the pattern appears on the disc at 'prints'. At 'layer after layer' three coloured layers stack. At 'billions' a zoom circle shows a grid of tiny switches flicking on and off; a label 'billions' and an on/off switch icon at 'switches'.

cenas.acao: Split screen: on Lumen, Kip imagined a rare glowing crystal on a museum pedestal; in 2026, a plain pile of sand turns into a chip.
cenas.narracao: On Lumen, I thought brains like this needed rare crystals. Back then, they started as *sand*, purified and printed with light.
cenas.visual: Bottom half (my time) first at 'Lumen': a rare glowing violet crystal on a light pedestal in the museum. Top half (old days) at 'Back then': a plain sand pile; at 'sand' it flows into a wafer and the wafer shines into a chip at 'printed with light'.

cenas.acao: The chip wakes up and the machine's little screen asks where exactly they are in space and time, with a map pin and a clock; Kip has no answer.
cenas.narracao: The chip woke up. Then the machine asked me a question: where *exactly* are we, in space and in time? I had no idea.
cenas.visual: Garage. At 'woke' slot 3 glows and the frame hums. At 'question' a small screen on the machine shows a big '?'; at 'space' a map pin icon, at 'time' a clock icon. Kip shrugs at 'no idea'; Ben scratches his head. 'TO BE CONTINUED' end card.
